inputs.text:
Genre: Epic Power Ballad, Cinematic Pop Rock, Orchestral Strings.
Vocal: Powerful female vocal, raspy and emotional belt in the chorus, breathy head voice in the verses, layered choir harmonies in the final climax.
Mood: Heart-wrenching, nostalgic, bittersweet triumph.
Structure: Soft piano & string intro -> Verse 1 (intimate, breathy) -> Pre-chorus (building tension with drums) -> Chorus (explosive, full band, belted high notes) -> Verse 2 -> Chorus -> Bridge (acapella with faint strings) -> Key-change Final Chorus (choir joins) -> Outro (piano fading).
Lyric Theme: A letter to a lost lover, using metaphors of autumn leaves and distant lighthouses. Expressing gratitude for the pain that made me stronger.
